description: Per-example negative cosine similarity between a prediction and an L2-normalized detached target, implementing the one-sided stop-gradient term; concatenate both cross-view directions to form the symmetric objective (Chen and He, §3 Eqs. (1), (3), and (4); src/topologies/implementations/losses/stop_gradient_twins.py:31-46). Trainer bindings use src/topologies/training/recipes/structured_objective.py:36-50.

examples.code:
import tempfile
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from topologies import Trainer, build, synth
root = tempfile.mkdtemp()
@synth.generator
def paired_views(ctx):
    first = torch.randn(4, generator=ctx.rng.torch)
    second = first + 0.1 * torch.randn(4, generator=ctx.rng.torch)
    return {"inputs": synth.Tensor(torch.stack((first, second)))}
dataset = synth.Spec("stop-gradient-twins", generator=paired_views, size=8, splits={"train": 1.0}, seed=7, root=root, monitor="none").run()
train = dataset.for_recipe("structured-objective", split="train")
class TwinModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.encoder = build("mlp", "tiny", in_features=4, out_features=3)
        self.predictor = build("mlp", "tiny", in_features=3, out_features=3)
    def forward(self, inputs):
        batch_size, view_count, feature_count = inputs.shape
        embeddings = self.encoder(inputs.reshape(batch_size * view_count, feature_count)).reshape(batch_size, view_count, -1)
        predictions = self.predictor(embeddings.reshape(batch_size * view_count, -1)).reshape(batch_size, view_count, -1)
        return {"predictions": torch.cat((predictions[:, 0], predictions[:, 1]), dim=0), "targets": torch.cat((embeddings[:, 1], embeddings[:, 0]), dim=0)}
trainer = Trainer(TwinModel(), train, recipe="structured-objective", recipe_config={"loss": "stop-gradient-twins", "bindings": {"logits_or_prediction": {"output": "predictions"}, "targets": {"output": "targets"}}}, batch_size=4, max_epochs=1, device="cpu")
trainer.fit()
examples.title: Train a shared two-view encoder with stop-gradient twins loss

name: Stop-Gradient Twins Loss

parameters.additional parameters: no additional parameters are supported; unsupported keys in **params raise ValueError
parameters.ignore_index: must be None because this embedding objective has no indexed labels
parameters.logits_or_prediction: finite floating-point prediction tensor shaped [B,D] with B >= 1, D >= 1, and nonzero L2 norm for every vector
parameters.reduction: none returns one negative cosine value per example, mean averages examples, or sum totals examples (default mean)
parameters.targets: finite floating-point target tensor matching prediction shape, dtype, and device with nonzero L2 norm for every vector; detached before normalization
